title: Punctured H¹ comparison
statement: For a Noetherian local ring R and its punctured spectrum W, if the second local cohomology module of R supported at the maximal ideal is subsingleton, then Modules.H of the unit sheaf on W in degree one is subsingleton. Here local cohomology is the filtered colimit of Ext^2_R(R/m^n, R) for positive powers of the maximal ideal m. The Noetherian ring uses [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Schemes and their structure sheaves use [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Tag 0BK0, Lemma 51.8.2(2); Tag 0A6T, Lemma 51.2.1; Tag 0AVY, Lemma 47.11.1

proof.text: Apply the Ext-colimit versus derived-torsion comparison in degree two to the finitely generated maximal ideal and the module R.
Apply puncture localization to identify the first cohomology of the unit structure module with the same degree-two derived-torsion module.

For two classes x,y, apply injectivity of the puncture equivalence and then injectivity of the inverse algebraic isomorphism. Their images in localCohomology coincide by the given Subsingleton hypothesis.

theorem punctured_h_one_subsingleton_of_local_cohomology_vanishing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (hzero : Subsingleton ((localCohomology (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) 2).obj
      ((ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R))).carrier) :
    Subsingleton (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) 1)
